title: YummyMC
description: YummyMC is a food-themed survival SMP with a friendly community, custom cosmetics, events, and a fun player-driven economy.
body:
YummyMC SMP

Build, explore, and play together in a community full of creativity and fun.

Features:
• Jobs system to earn money and level up your skills
• Land Claims to protect your builds
• Rewards and Battle Pass with exclusive items
• Custom Resource Pack for a unique experience
• Events, quests, and challenges
• Friendly and active community
• Teams
• Jobs
• Daily Rewards

Be part of the YummyMC adventure — where the community builds the world together!
